title_zh: 莫文蔚：风格多变的香港女歌手
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (3/20): Karen Mok, Hong Kong's Shape-Shifting Diva
note_en: The text uses 以...受到喜爱 "to be loved for/by means of...": 以多变的音乐风格和优雅的气质受到大家喜爱 "loved for her ever-changing style and elegant presence." 以 introduces the means or the reason and always comes before the verb, where English puts "for..." or "with..." after it. The text also uses the near-synonym 凭借 (凭借独特的声音 "thanks to her distinctive voice").
